description:
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Thopter Foundry by paying {1} and sacrificing Sword of the Meek, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token and causing you to gain 1 life.
When the Thopter enters, Rosie and Sword of the Meek trigger.
Resolve the Rosie trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Devoted Druid.
Resolve the Sword of the Meek trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Thopter token.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
